shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
schematic figures with limbs shown in relief
symmetrically paired motifs flanking a central axis
repeated small incised signs covering the surface
justification: Both are tall grey stone monuments with a rounded top and low-relief carving that includes discs/rings and paired, symmetrically disposed schematic figures, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a flat rectangular panel neatly divided into a figured lunette above many ruled rows of small repeated signs, while B is a three-dimensional sculpted block whose sparse, bold, rounded motifs float freely on a curved body with no registers or text.
